program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (17.0, 13.0, 20.0),     # input pair (high gm/Id -> low Vgs, more gm, bigger W)
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # long L -> big area -> low flicker
    "itail": (40e-6, 30e-6, 60e-6),
    "gmid4": (8.0, 6.0, 11.0),       # PMOS mirror + 2nd stage (matched density)
    "L4":    (1.0, 0.5, 1.5),
    "i7":    (140e-6, 100e-6, 180e-6),
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidb": (16.0, 12.0, 19.0),     # NMOS bias gm/Id -> low Vdsat for tail
    "cc":    (1.2e-12, 0.7e-12, 1.8e-12),
    "rzk":   (2.0, 1.2, 3.5),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail, i7, cc = p["itail"], p["i7"], p["cc"]
    i1 = itail / 2
    gmidb = p["gmidb"]

    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], itail, vds=0.2)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], i7, vds=0.9)

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.5)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], i1, vds=1.0)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], i7, vds=0.9)

    rz = p["rzk"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output (x) side -> vinp non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * cc / (c1 * cl + cc * (c1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * cc * (rz - 1.0 / m7.gm))
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    slew = min(itail / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    power = 1.98 * (iref + itail + i7)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.2
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * m1.gm) * (1 + m4.gm / m1.gm))
    # flicker calibrated to previous sim: 480 nV at gm1(14.2*14.4u), L=1, gate area ~ cgg
    gm_prev = 14.2 * 14.45e-6
    fl_ratio = math.sqrt(gm_prev / m1.gm) * math.sqrt((gm_prev / 14.2 * 1.0) / (m1.gm / p["gmid1"] * p["L1"] ** 2 + 1e-18)) 
    noise = math.sqrt((4.7e-7 * min(fl_ratio, 3.0)) ** 2 + noise_th ** 2)
    cmrr = db(2 * m1.gm / (mt.gds + 1e-12)) + 6
    psrr = gain_db - 5
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr}
